content: GitHub protected branch rules can require pull-request reviews and status checks; stale approvals can be dismissed and push access restricted. Use provider branch protection as enforcement complementing the Markdown workflow. Official docs: https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/configuring-branches-and-merges-in-your-repository/managing-protected-branches/about-protected-branches and https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/reference/status-checks
